hero.question: Will Marco Rubio win the 2028 Republican presidential nomination?
hero.prob_take:
At 25.9%, the market is pricing Rubio as a distant third option behind Trump and DeSantis, essentially saying he has a 1-in-4 shot at the nomination despite being Secretary of State and a recognizable establishment figure.

The jump from 18.1% in 24 hours screams overcorrection to positive Trump transition news, but Rubio's actual path to 2028 remains murky if Trump runs again or if a fresh face like JD Vance enters the race.

daily_take.headline: Rubio's 2028 surge signals Trump's bench just got deeper
daily_take.deck: Marco Rubio jumped 7.8 points to 25.9% in 24 hours on $11.9M volume, making him the clearest Trump successor bet in the field. The move isn't random noise. This screams insider money recognizing that a loyal, media-savvy Secretary of State who doesn't threaten Trump's 2028 power position just became the Republican establishment's favorite heir. Smart money is treating this as a 1-to-2 year hold. The real question: is 26% actually his ceiling, or does this run to 35% if Trump stays out of the 2028 primary?
